hooks.text: The shining star millions watched in 1957 was actually space junk.
Most people looking at Sputnik 1 were actually watching space garbage.
An 85-foot-long piece of Soviet rocket trash fooled the entire world.

title: The Secret Giant Behind Sputnik
description: Discover why the bright light millions saw during the famous 1957 Sputnik launch wasn't the actual satellite at all.

beats.text: It completed one orbit every 96 minutes, broadcasting a distinct beep-beep-beep signal across the globe.

beats.text: Yet the tiny, 184-pound spacecraft remained practically impossible to spot with the naked eye.

beats.text: The bright light people actually saw was Sputnik's massive, 85-foot-long discarded rocket booster.
